summary: Full texts of all three TamaFlex (NXT15906F6) RCTs confirm placebo-controlled benefits on their primary outcomes: six-minute walk in non-arthritic adults with exertional knee pain (250-400 mg/day, 90 days), and WOMAC in knee OA (250 mg/day, 56 and 30 days). All three get eligible contexts for Joint & Bone Health, as whole-formula evidence; they are small, short trials from one development programme. A new applicability block limits credit to knee joint pain and function.

applicability.studied_population: Adults aged about 40-70 with mild-to-moderate knee osteoarthritis, or non-arthritic adults with exercise-related knee pain, taking TamaFlex 250-400 mg/day for 30-90 days.

population.description: 90 non-arthritic adults (15 men and 15 women per arm) with knee pain after physical exertion; 89 completed (one placebo dropout).

study_contexts.study_design: Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled three-arm trial, 90 days; primary outcome six-minute walk distance; paracetamol up to 2,000 mg/day allowed as rescue.

dose.administration_frequency: 125 or 200 mg capsule twice daily pre breakfast and pre dinner
dose.reported_regimen: [250, 400] mg/day; 90 days; 125 or 200 mg capsule twice daily pre breakfast and pre dinner

normalization.basis: Reported study-material daily dose, not a universal threshold or equivalence to other preparation.

source_provenance.location: Full text (PMC6643110): Methods (design, groups and capsule dosing, outcomes, rescue medication, power), Results Table 3-5 paragraphs.

co_therapies: Paracetamol up to 2,000 mg/day as rescue analgesia; no other pain-relieving interventions.

outcomes.name: Primary six-minute walk distance change vs placebo: +29.23 m (250 mg) and +41.83 m (400 mg) vs +5.55 m (p<0.001 and p<0.0001).
Secondary stair-climb, VAS, WOMAC subscales and knee flexion improved vs placebo, some from day 14.

limitations: Whole formula, not component amount/efficacy transfer; separate trials OApopulations.

Whole TamaFlex (NXT15906F6: tamarind seed and turmeric rhizome extracts) formula; not evidence for either component alone. Small, short Indian trials from one development programme. Returned A026 'source-content hold' resolved by full-text verification; credit limited to knee joint pain and function.

population.description: 90 adults aged 40-70 with radiographic Kellgren-Lawrence grade II-III knee osteoarthritis, randomized 30 per arm (placebo, NXT15906F6 250 mg/day, NXT19185 300 mg/day).

study_contexts.study_design: Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled three-arm trial, 56 days; primary outcome WOMAC versus placebo.

dose.administration_frequency: One 250 mg capsule daily for 56 days.
dose.reported_regimen: [250] mg/day; 56 days; one capsule after breakfast

normalization.basis: Reported study-material daily dose, not a universal threshold or equivalence to other preparation.

source_provenance.location: Full text (PMC8791717): Methods 2.1-2.4 (test items, capsules, randomization, primary outcome), Results WOMAC paragraph and Table 2, COI.

co_therapies: Source-reported concurrent-care/restriction context: Subjects were excluded if they had a history of using or were currently using immunosuppressive drugs, corticosteroid or hyaluronic acid injections, glucosamine/chondroitin supplements or any analgesics or NSAIDs.

Source-reported concurrent-care/restriction context: The study participants also did not take acetaminophen/paracetamol, ibuprofen, aspirin, other NSAIDs, other analgesics (OTC or prescription), or any herbal products in the past seven days of the screening visit.
Source-reported concurrent-care/restriction context: Rescue Medication A daily dose of 2000 mg acetaminophen (four x 500 mg) was prescribed as the rescue medication in the study.
Source-reported concurrent-care/restriction context: However, the subjects were not allowed to take the medication at least two days before each evaluation.
Source-reported concurrent-care/restriction context: Use of the rescue medication by the individual participant during the trial was recorded appropriately in the study-related documents.
Source-reported concurrent-care/restriction context: Rescue Medication None of the participants consumed rescue medication during the study.

outcomes.name: Primary WOMAC total reduced 41.86% from baseline with NXT15906F6 (TamaFlex) and significantly versus placebo at day 56 (P<0.05).

limitations: NXT 19185 includes Garcinia different formula, not equivalence; small trial.
Only the NXT15906F6 (TamaFlex) arm applies to this record; the NXT19185 arm adds Garcinia mangostana and is a different formula.

dose.administration_frequency: 250 mg NXT15906F6 daily after breakfast for 30 days.
dose.reported_regimen: [250] mg/day; 30 days; two capsules after breakfast daily

normalization.basis: Reported study-material daily dose, not a universal threshold or equivalence to other preparation.

outcomes.name: Primary total WOMAC reduced versus placebo from day 5 through day 30 (P<0.001); WOMAC pain fell 19.79%, 31.86% and 38.11% from baseline on days 5, 14 and 30.

limitations: WOMAC early positive but VASday 5 p.318; no universal 5 day pain claim.
